q1.q: How long does a project take?
q1.a: It depends on scope. A visual identity usually takes six weeks; a digital product, two to three months. Each service lists its typical timeline on the services page.

q2.a: Thirty percent on signature, the rest split across the agreed deliveries. Projects longer than three months can be billed monthly.

q3.q: Do you work with the client's in-house team?
q3.a: Yes, and we prefer it. Our job is to deliver the project and leave the team able to carry on without us.

q4.a: You do. Every editable file, the code repository and the accounts we used are handed over at the end of the project.

q5.q: Do you offer maintenance after delivery?
q5.a: We offer an optional monthly contract for evolution and support. It is not required to receive the project.

about.title: A small studio, on purpose
about.p1: We started in 2012 as two designers taking on brand projects. Today we are 14 people across design, strategy and engineering, and we stay small because that is how we get to be present in every project.
about.p2: There is no new business department here. The person you meet in the first call is the person who will run the work.
